dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: We’re going to the mines, with Vlad and the others. We'll post a guard at the entrance and get to work. Grab as much silver ore as we can before Brencis realises what’s going on.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Yanna
dialogue.line: Coen! Oh, God… it’s really you…

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: We need to block all the entrances, now! Dad –

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You've always said to stand up for the weak, to help if I can.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: You'd better pray it doesn't get worse.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: What can happen if Brencis decides your mother is too weak for his liking?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: We all do that, every damn week. That's not how they turn people.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You weren't there that night. You didn't see her drinking the vrakhir's blood.

q002_01_pieter_warning: Be careful. The soldiers are already here. They brought the uriashi, too.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: You've seen what Brencis does to people he considers too weak.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Yanna
dialogue.line: Shush, Mirto. You'll make Lunka cry again.

dialogue.speaker: A55A46CF46DF24C08CF9579D6DB6620C
dialogue.line: I won't feed her against her will.

dialogue.speaker: F357129D4CEBD63E94A26080F033AAF3
dialogue.line: It must be hard for you.

dialogue.speaker: Vladimir
dialogue.line: We're losing time. You know it.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You want to help mum, or keep interrogating me?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: You make a mistake, you own up to it.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: You're sharp, son. But... careful it doesn't get you into trouble.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You've never told me that story.

dialogue.speaker: B8E30C2B4B4497E759E4DFA7ECBF3A6C
dialogue.line: Dad, if you want to talk about this...

dialogue.speaker: 83CF240D46245381EF6E0C8397C25FF5
dialogue.line: Has it got something to do with Vladimir?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: You think I relish this? The responsibility they want to put on my shoulders?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You came at me like you wanted to kill me!

dialogue.speaker: D792525740176ED442F5ECAC7F1AFD09
dialogue.line: I'll wait with you. [Skip time until the mass]

dialogue.speaker: 4313EA8F45C8D1AF80B1A4A8DBFA9AD0
dialogue.line: People say the mines are haunted.

dialogue.speaker: E88AB2D444337FA872E2E7A9CA375DA1
dialogue.line: This plan is crazy. We'll never win.

dialogue.speaker: B4660CC841FD50F7D7B36EA33707C3A1
dialogue.line: Whatever you decide, you can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Florin
dialogue.line: Yes, he drinks our blood, and we drink his. We nourish Brencis, and he protects us from harm.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: Shhh. We don't want to attract attention.

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: You sure this is a good time?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: You think that's how it works? Folks waiting politely for you to warm up?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Shit! Dad, I said hold on!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Esme
dialogue.line: [scoff] What sort of a question is that?

dialogue.speaker: Coen
dialogue.line: Your olatki. Your smile. Your voice.

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: Run? Where to? What are you talking about?

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: Why is he not with you?!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Mirto
dialogue.line: I'm just as strong as dad! Only shorter!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Esme
dialogue.line: Where are those two? Always sleeping in...

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Lunka
dialogue.line: I'll eat and eat and eat until I'm as big as Coen!

dialogue.speaker: Character.Secondary.Pieter
dialogue.line: Get a move on! Idle hands are the devil's workshop!

dialogue.speaker: Brencis
dialogue.line: We do. But you'll need motivation.

vt_c: Are you trying to provoke me?
The weather's never what you want it to be.
